title: Bill George, the Orpheum tour and Tony Jackson in Chicago
summary: Manetta describes Bill George getting jobs and sending for Baquet for the Orpheum, then his 1913 Chicago visit hearing Tony Jackson at a State Street cabaret, with a garbled ASR loop in the middle.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene
